description: ENTSOG prepares the Ten-Year Network Development Plan for European gas, which gives an overview of gas infrastructure and its future development, maps the integrated network under development scenarios, and includes a supply adequacy outlook and a resilience assessment. The page, read on 2026-09-26, says Regulation (EU) 2024/1789 requires a TYNDP every two years and lists editions back to 2009. For TYNDP 2026 it lists the draft infrastructure report and a projects visualisation platform (12 August 2026), Annex B maps for hydrogen and natural gas, the Annex A list of projects and project tables (May 2026), and methodology annexes. TYNDP 2024, final in March 2026, adds Annex C capacities for methane and hydrogen, a hydrogen infrastructure gaps report, a natural gas system assessment with visualisation platforms, and cost-benefit analysis packages. Documents are free to download from the page; no licence is stated. Caveats: project lists are promoter submissions, not decisions. Simulation uses are future network and capacity inputs for gas and hydrogen network flow, capacity planning and supply resilience models. Related records: data-entsog-transparency-platform gives operational flows, and data-h2-infrastructure-map-europe-ehb maps hydrogen projects.
